verdict.rationale: Ranking inspection is a fair axis for a search engine like Orama. The evidence pack covers full-text, vector and hybrid search, facets, fields boosting and pinning rules. Nothing documents per-result relevance scores, score breakdowns or an explain feature that would show why a result ranked where it did. Boosting and pinning are tuning controls, not inspection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
